name: Cercus Pronotum
source:
The world above the Eternal Flesh is full of layers, rumors, and forgotten warnings. What will you find when you venture too far?

[From [url=https://ckvn.itch.io/cercus-pronotum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
永恆血肉之上的世界層層疊疊，充斥著傳聞和早已被遺忘的警告。要是你探索得太遠，將會發現什麼？

［摘自[url=https://ckvn.itch.io/cercus-pronotum]Itch.io[/url]］
